BOOT_HEIGHT_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Tunnel boot height (top of the boot deck above the floor) when the params give none. Bedroom Style 3 measures 398; the east-west bedroom 418.

WARDROBE_WIDTH_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Wardrobe width from the van's side wall to its inner face (the opening edge) when the params give none. Same on both sides: the north-south bedroom is symmetric by rule.

OHC_BOTTOM_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Underside of the overhead block above the floor when the params give none.

BOOT_DECK_THICKNESS_MM.doc: Tunnel boot deck (the board the wardrobes and the mattress sit on): 18 mm structural stock, wall to wall and the full depth of the body. Style 3 measures 18.

WARDROBE_WIDTH_MIN_MM.doc: Narrowest wardrobe allowed (from the side wall).

OPENING_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Least clear height between the boot deck and the overhead underside — room for the mattress and to sit up.

OHC_HEIGHT_MIN_MM.doc: Least overhead block height under the lowest roof over the body.

BED_FRAME_QUEEN_WIDTH_MM.doc: Outer width of the queen bed frame / bed box. A product size, not a design number: the opening between the wardrobes must be at least this wide and the bed box is exactly this wide. Style 3 measures 1508 (side panel outer faces).

DOOR_PANEL_THICKNESS_DEFAULT_MM.doc: Wardrobe colour panel (door stock) thickness when the params give none.

WARDROBE_T2_BACK_MM.doc: Y from the room face to the back of T2 — the one fixed distance of the wardrobe top. The colour panel runs full height (to the roof) from here toward the nose; in front of it the panel is cut down to the T3 seat. Style 3: 66.

WARDROBE_T2_THICKNESS_MM.doc: T2 (rear top rail) thickness; it stands on T3 with its back at WARDROBE_T2_BACK.

WARDROBE_T2_HEIGHT_MM.doc: T2 height at its back, measured to the roof there. Sets the T3 seat: T3 top = roof(T2 back) − this − T3 clearance. The roof slopes, so T2 is taller at its front (Style 3: 35 back, 38 front).

WARDROBE_T1_THICKNESS_MM.doc: T1 (front top rail) thickness; it stands on T3 directly in front of T2.

WARDROBE_T1_OVERSIZE_MM.doc: T1 is cut this much taller than the roof at its back (a flat top: the three-axis router cannot cut the slope) — trimmed to the roof on site.

WARDROBE_T3_THICKNESS_MM.doc: T3 (top panel over the wardrobe) thickness.

WARDROBE_T3_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: Clearance between T3 top and the T1 / T2 undersides, and above T3 in the colour panel's pocket.

WARDROBE_T3_DEPTH_MM.doc: T3 depth from the room face toward the nose.

WARDROBE_T3_LIP_DEPTH_MM.doc: Pocket in the colour panel behind the T2 back (Y from WARDROBE_T2_BACK) that T3's tail slides into; its height is T3 + clearance.

WARDROBE_T3_TAIL_CLEARANCE_MM.doc: T3's tail stops this short of the pocket end. Beyond the tail T3 is notched back to the colour panel's wall-side face.

WARDROBE_PANEL_MIN_HEIGHT_MM.doc: Least colour-panel height between the boot deck and the T3 seat.
